description: Apply the same set of field changes to many tasks at once (up to 100). Returns a per-task success/error report. Use to mass-change status, priority, due date, or add/remove assignees across a batch of tasks.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when task_ids are custom task IDs instead of native ClickUp IDs. Requires team_id.

task_ids.description: Task ids to update (1–100 per call).

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

update.description: Fields applied to every task in task_ids (only the provided fields change).

archived.description: Set true to archive every task, false to unarchive.

assignees_add.description: User ids to ADD as assignees on every task.

assignees_rem.description: User ids to REMOVE from assignees on every task.

due_date.description: New due date for every task (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

name.description: New name to set on every task.

priority.description: New priority for every task (1=urgent..4=low), or null to clear it.

status.description: New status name to set on every task.

name: update_bulk_tasks
